ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-2,
Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols and indications as shown on
Map No. 10-L in the area bound by:

      West 46th Street; South Lamon Avenue; West 47th Street; and South Lavergne Avenue,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                       ___________________________
                                                       Michael D. Rodriguez
                                                       Alderman, 22nd Ward




Common Address:
4640 S. Lamon Avenue
